---
title: "RNA-seq Quality Control（手动检查）"
output: html_document
---

本 Notebook **不属于自动 Pipeline**。所有分析代码块默认 `eval=FALSE`：请逐块运行、调整过滤阈值和画布尺寸，确认后再运行保存代码块。`total_counts` 始终来自原始 counts，不能用 TPM/FPKM 的列和替代测序深度。

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(eval = FALSE)
```

## 1. 输入与样本选择

```{r input}
find_project_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  candidates <- normalizePath(c(start, file.path(start, "..")), mustWork = FALSE)
  found <- candidates[file.exists(file.path(candidates, "config.yml")) |
                      file.exists(file.path(candidates, "config.example.yml"))]
  if (!length(found)) stop("请在项目根目录或 notebooks 目录运行。")
  found[[1]]
}
project_root <- find_project_root()
config_file <- file.path(project_root, "config.yml")
if (!file.exists(config_file)) stop("请先创建 config.yml。")
config <- yaml::read_yaml(config_file)

# 如果服务器存在冲突的 ggplot2 版本，务必在其他绘图包加载之前执行此块。
# ggplot2_lib <- config$runtime$ggplot2_lib_loc
# if (!is.null(ggplot2_lib) && nzchar(ggplot2_lib)) {
#   desired <- normalizePath(file.path(ggplot2_lib, "ggplot2"), mustWork = TRUE)
#   if ("ggplot2" %in% loadedNamespaces() &&
#       normalizePath(getNamespaceInfo("ggplot2", "path")) != desired) {
#     stop("当前 R 会话已加载其他 ggplot2；请重启 R 再运行此 Notebook。")
#   }
#   library(ggplot2, lib.loc = ggplot2_lib)
# } else {
#   library(ggplot2)
# }
source(file.path(project_root, "src/qc/F.quality_control.R"))

input <- config$input
metadata <- readr::read_tsv(file.path(project_root, input$metadata_file), show_col_types = FALSE)
counts <- qc_read_matrix(file.path(project_root, input$counts_file), gene_column = input$gene_column)
tpm_file <- file.path(project_root, config$gsva$tpm_file)
tpm <- if (file.exists(tpm_file)) qc_read_matrix(tpm_file, input$gene_column) else NULL
# 项目没有 FPKM 时保持 NULL。
fpkm <- NULL

# 可设为 c("CQ", "N396") 等；NULL 为 metadata 中全部 Group/Cycle。
selected_groups <- NULL
selected_cycles <- NULL
qc <- qc_prepare_data(
  counts, metadata, tpm = tpm, fpkm = fpkm,
  groups = selected_groups, cycles = selected_cycles,
  sample_column = input$sample_column,
  group_column = input$group_column,
  cycle_column = input$cycle_column
)
table(qc$metadata[[input$group_column]], qc$metadata[[input$cycle_column]])
```

## 2. 基础 QC 表及图

MT 与核糖体基因使用基因符号匹配；如果 Gene 是 Ensembl ID，请先改 `mitochondrial_pattern` / `ribosomal_pattern`，或转换为基因符号。

```{r basic-qc}
metrics <- qc_calculate_metrics(
  qc,
  tpm_thresholds = c(0.1, 1),
  mitochondrial_pattern = "^MT-",
  ribosomal_pattern = "^(RPL|RPS)"
)
print(metrics)

# 在这里指定项目颜色：名称对应 metadata 的 Group / Cycle；其他名称自动补色。
custom_group_colors <- c(CQ = "#4C78A8", N396 = "#F28E2B")
custom_cycle_colors <- c(R0 = "#A8DADC", R1 = "#457B9D", R2 = "#F4A261", R3 = "#E76F51")
resolve_colors <- function(levels, custom, palette = "Dark 3") {
  colors <- setNames(grDevices::hcl.colors(length(levels), palette), levels)
  if (length(custom)) {
    if (is.null(names(custom)) || anyNA(names(custom)) || any(!nzchar(names(custom))) ||
        anyDuplicated(names(custom))) stop("自定义颜色必须有唯一的 Group/Cycle 名称。")
    unused <- setdiff(names(custom), levels)
    if (length(unused)) warning("这些颜色名称不在当前数据中，将忽略：", paste(unused, collapse = ", "))
    used <- intersect(levels, names(custom))
    colors[used] <- custom[used]
    tryCatch(grDevices::col2rgb(colors), error = function(e) stop("颜色值无效：", conditionMessage(e)))
  }
  colors
}
group_colors <- resolve_colors(qc$group_order, custom_group_colors)
cycle_colors <- resolve_colors(qc$cycle_order, custom_cycle_colors, palette = "Set 2")

p_library <- qc_plot_metric(metrics, "total_counts", qc, group_colors, cycle_colors)
p_detected <- qc_plot_metric(metrics, "detected_genes_count_gt0", qc, group_colors, cycle_colors)
p_tpm <- if (!is.null(qc$tpm)) qc_plot_metric(metrics, "detected_genes_tpm_gt1", qc, group_colors, cycle_colors) else NULL
p_mt <- qc_plot_metric(metrics, "mitochondrial_pct", qc, group_colors, cycle_colors)
p_ribo <- qc_plot_metric(metrics, "ribosomal_pct", qc, group_colors, cycle_colors)
p_library
p_detected
p_tpm
p_mt
p_ribo
```

## 3. VST、PCA 与样本相关性

默认使用 DESeq2 的 blind VST。仅在需要快速预览或暂未安装 DESeq2 时，可改成 `method = "log_cpm"`；两种变换的 PCA/相关性不应混为同一结果。

```{r pca-correlation}
transformed <- qc_transform_counts(qc, method = "vst", min_count = 10, min_samples = 3)
p_pca <- qc_plot_pca(transformed, qc, group_colors = group_colors,
                     label_samples = TRUE, top_genes = NULL)
p_pca

heatmap <- qc_plot_correlation(
  transformed, qc, cluster_samples = TRUE,
  annotation_colors = list(Group = group_colors, Cycle = cycle_colors)
)
grid::grid.newpage()
grid::grid.draw(heatmap$gtable)
```

## 4. Housekeeping 表达

此项需要 TPM。基因符号可直接修改，缺失基因会给出警告；`mean` / `median` 是每个样本对可用 housekeeping 基因的汇总。

```{r housekeeping}
housekeeping_genes <- c("ACTB", "GAPDH", "B2M", "RPLP0", "HPRT1", "TBP",
                        "PPIA", "PGK1", "YWHAZ", "SDHA", "RPL13A", "TUBB")
p_housekeeping <- qc_plot_housekeeping(qc, housekeeping_genes, summary = "per_gene", group_colors = group_colors)
p_housekeeping_mean <- qc_plot_housekeeping(qc, housekeeping_genes, summary = "mean", group_colors = group_colors)
p_housekeeping
p_housekeeping_mean
```

## 5. 确认后保存

这里的尺寸和文件名仅为示例，请先观察图形再运行本块。相关性热图返回 pheatmap 对象，保存其 `gtable`。

```{r save-qc}
output_dir <- file.path(project_root, "figures", "qc")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
readr::write_tsv(metrics, file.path(output_dir, "sample_qc_metrics.tsv"))
ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "library_size.pdf"), p_library, width = 9, height = 5)
ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "detected_genes.pdf"), p_detected, width = 9, height = 5)
if (!is.null(p_tpm)) ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "detected_genes_tpm.pdf"), p_tpm, width = 9, height = 5)
ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "mitochondrial_pct.pdf"), p_mt, width = 9, height = 5)
ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "ribosomal_pct.pdf"), p_ribo, width = 9, height = 5)
ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "pca.pdf"), p_pca, width = 7, height = 6)
ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "sample_correlation.pdf"), heatmap$gtable, width = 9, height = 8)
ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "housekeeping.pdf"), p_housekeeping, width = 12, height = 8)
ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "housekeeping_mean.pdf"), p_housekeeping_mean, width = 8, height = 5)
```
